pull_request.title: Calorimeter: propose LAr side-neck routing and gap mitigation
pull_request.head: codex/lar-gap-hadron-options
pull_request.body:
The matched10k LAr study shows a weak barrel/endcap handover. This draft now proposes a concrete first routing topology: complete outward offsets in barrel outer-side necks before the barrel end face, run straight axial service lines outside the endcap, and turn outward in the rear service break. Endcap services leave at the rear.

The proposed one-metre side-neck band, R3029 bus and R4800 exterior handoff are screening reservations. Existing pipes,4xOD bends, station/channel counts and planning capacity are retained initially. The100mm utility offset has a739.403mm legacy envelope; its rear turn needs490mm with both axial-face clearances, leaving only10mm in the500mm break. Ports, supports, boards, complete bundle packing and external handoff remain engineering gates. Moving the endcap inward does not widen the full radial exit while the HCAL barrel remains fixed.

The accompanying assessment also considers selective layer/region coarsening, active-coverage changes and residual-gap instrumentation. Channel reduction alone leaves the existing cryogenic bend unchanged; lossless regrouping also preserves the10k all-cell energy sum. This is not evidence of calibrated hadron-collider superiority.

Validation: independent pinned SysArch/PhysVal baseline contributions, explicit new SysArch routing input, analytic S-bend/swept-elbow/clearance/capacity checks, three existing service controls from the original screen, project/session/inventory checks and disjoint usage accounting. Prior e5e1ecd CI was green; no new-head CI completion is inferred. No detector geometry, pressure-vessel/thermal design, native route or shower validation changed or completed.

Related: PR75 transition review; merged PR138/139 placement campaign and PR14010k comparison. Selected user requests, sources, roles/work labels and available exact token logging are retained. Draft for technical discussion; no design acceptance, readiness or merge authorization inferred.
